policy: A previous audit URL is evidence that a source was once individually reviewed, not proof the source is active, first party or establishes the exact physical Catholic building.
The P38 lead URL is inherited discovery provenance and must not be treated as source-confirmed.
Conflicting non-Catholic operating-site records remain explicit eligibility exceptions, never automatically promoted.
The mapping row may overlap a global acquisition record; reuse same candidate ID, do not create duplicate Place.
No Church, source, schedule, map coordinate or public Place is published from this research file.
